bibliography.note: Mark D. Gautreau and R. Allen Curry, "Ecology and Status of the Redbreast Sunfish, Lepomis auritus, in Yoho Lake, New Brunswick", Northeastern Naturalist 19(4): 653–664 (2012), doi:10.1656/045.019.0409

claims.claim: Yoho Lake back-calculated lengths 36, 64, 88, 111, 127, 141 mm at ages 1–6; mean 12.5 cm, 42.6 g
claims.note: The abstract gives average total length 12.5 ± 3.1 cm and weight 42.6 ± 27.3 g (agrees, unconfirmed under rule 1). The back-calculated series is not in the abstract; COSEWIC 2008 (ch. 6) gives 36.2, 64.4, 87.8, 110.6, 127.2 and 140.9 mm for 0+ through 5+ (end of each growing season, 27 scales, Yoho 2005) from Gautreau & Curry 2006.

claims.claim: New Brunswick redbreast males guard for 7–10 days
claims.note: not in the abstract; needs the full text

claims.claim: Yoho Lake diet: amphipods ≈ 50 %, caddis ≈ 20 % by number (n = 10)
claims.note: not in the abstract. COSEWIC 2008 Table 4 (Yoho Lake, September 2005, from Gautreau & Curry 2006) gives amphipods 114 of 229 items (49.8 %) and caddis larvae 45 (19.7 %), with no count of fish; the number of stomachs (n = 10) needs the 2012 full text

claims.claim: Yoho Lake (131 ha, mean depth 3.7 m) held only 325–744 redbreast by Petersen estimate; the oldest age class (6+) averaged 16 cm
claims.note: The abstract says only "Population estimates averaged 386 from 2005 to 2007". COSEWIC 2008 reports 325 (Schnabel, September 2005), 447 (2006) and 743 (Petersen with 2006 marks, 2007) for a targeted 8.9 ha — their mean (505) does not match the abstract's 386, so the 2012 estimates may differ, and the 2005 figure was a Schnabel, not a Petersen, estimate. COSEWIC gives Yoho as 131 ha in its text but 123.4 ha (mean depth 3.66 m, max 11.3 m) in its Table 2a. All need the full text.

claims.claim: 18–21-cm redbreast would weigh about 110–180 g by Yoho's length–weight relation and be at least 7–10 years old at Yoho growth (project estimate)
claims.note: the length–weight relation and growth curve are not in the abstract

claims.claim: first-year length 36.2 mm, back-calculated, "also Gautreau & Curry 2012"
claims.note: not in the abstract; COSEWIC 2008 gives 36.2 mm (0+) from Gautreau & Curry 2006

notes: Blocked: only the abstract (first-page image) is open. The abstract agrees with the paper's mean length and weight (12.5 cm, 42.6 g), and adds Yoho-only nest values from snorkel surveys in late June–early July 2005–2007: nests 52.4 ± 10.1 cm across, in water 43.9 ± 12.2 cm deep, on sand with small gravel, only 33 % associated with a physical structure; most adults and juveniles in dense vegetation and large woody debris. These differ slightly from the pooled Yoho + Oromocto values the paper takes from COSEWIC 2008 (50.9 cm, 43.2 cm; Oromocto 85 % within 1 m of rock or log). The abstract's population average (386, 2005–2007) does not match COSEWIC's 325/447/743, so the paper's "325–744 … by Petersen estimate" should be checked against the full text before use.
